features.acceptanceRationale: Detached verified worker facts and complete emission sets restore deleted owned output with content validation while current generator validators, artifact processors, syntax/ABI readers and final input/publication fences still run. The emission key separately includes the original parser files, search directories and absent inputs; a new include candidate yields miss then unchanged-input hit with identical managed bytes. Same-path source/reference/defines/model changes, extension registration/order/fingerprint changes and generated contribution bytes invalidate affected stages. Volatile/unverified/unfingerprinted inputs disable reuse; corrupt/incomplete entries regenerate. No consumer or native product compilation is implied. Native include root order, declared native/shim input bytes, generated source identities and parser builtin execution inputs remain tracked; changed mappings cannot replay old absolute native includes.
